title: Kindness, gratitude and boundaries
pages: The Lion and the Crane, printed pp. 1–2
notes: Discuss why the crane helps and how the lion responds. Invite children to imagine a grateful response. Source passage checked in archive OCR; adaptation still needs editorial review. Treat this as a fable, not an animal-rescue activity.

title: How a vibrating strip makes music
notes: The historical description identifies thin metal strips and rhythmic tapping. Use a modern teacher demonstration to explore vibration and rhythm. Source passage checked in archive OCR; instrument terminology and the explanation need review before a lesson is published.

title: Dreams, plans and assumptions
notes: Map the chain of imagined exchanges and identify which outcomes the character assumes. Source passage checked in archive OCR. The original contains domestic violence and caste and dowry assumptions; this is an editorial discussion candidate, not a child-ready retelling.
